basis_statement: Conservative SUPERVISOR-approved interim screening envelope (2026-10-07). Not a measured property, not a material-specific prior and not a calibrated uncertainty distribution. Literature close-woven analogue: E3 about 5-10 GPa, nu13/nu23 about 0.2-0.4, G13/G23 about 3-5 GPa. The G13/G23 lower bound is extended to the governed baseline 2.2 GPa, which is not claimed as literature-supported. Face-sheet thickness scatter is not part of this envelope (later t_face nuisance).

criterion.purpose: SPEC §5 uncertainty-budget bookkeeping only: below the criterion the constant may stay fixed (NEGLIGIBLE_FOR_BUDGET); otherwise INCLUDE_IN_UNCERTAINTY_BUDGET. Not a model-fit target, not a failure and never a reason to re-tune the model. Real-data interpretation (M7) uses the practical engineering target (D-066).

provenance: SUPERVISOR 2026-10-07: M6.4 interim screening envelope and frozen observation-mode set accepted (D-066)
SPEC §5 / §5.2 (0.3 % criterion, unchanged by D-055); SPEC §19 item 6 / D-061 (rescoped M6 gate)
governed baseline constants: carbon-property-set/v1 fixed values (forward_models/README.md)
baseline FE states: the archived CARBON-4C baseline shape packs (fe_shapes/README.md); no baseline solve
the forward models are used for the FE model only; FE-to-FE tracking does not depend on the registration
